Welcome  how can i help you

NAWODHAN is an initiative implemented by the Kerala Agro Business Company (KABCO) to promote sustainable farming practices and enhance agricultural productivity. It includes a comprehensive Grievance Redressal Mechanism to address the concerns of stakeholders such as farmers, employees, and partners. KABCO serves as the central coordinator for the project, facilitating the identification of vacant or underutilized land for hi-tech commercial farming in Kerala. The initiative also aims to provide access to international markets and support for export-related activities.
